messages:
Ashley: planning to roll out a small infra tweak for the inference-api deployment. proposal: reduce replicas from 6 -> 4 and change rollingUpdate to maxUnavailable: 1, maxSurge: 2. also adding a graceful preStop to drain connections for 10s.

Ashley: terraform change looks like:
```
resource "kubernetes_deployment" "inference_api" {
  spec {
    replicas = 4
    strategy { rolling_update { max_unavailable = 1 max_surge = 2 } }
  }
}
```

Ashley: k8s snippet for preStop + readiness tweak:
```
lifecycle:
  preStop:
    exec:
      command: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "sleep 10 && /opt/bin/drain-connections"]
readinessProbe:
  initialDelaySeconds: 5
  periodSeconds: 5
  timeoutSeconds: 2
```

Ashley: question: safe to apply now or should we do canary/cutover window? want to avoid HPA thrash and large cold-start tail latencies.

Morgan: +1 to doing a small canary. suggest 10% traffic for 15m then ramp. also add PodDisruptionBudget, otherwise reducing replicas + node drain could drop capacity.

Morgan: PDB example:
```
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
spec:
  minAvailable: 3
```

Raj: fyi HPA currently minReplicas=2 max=12. if you drop to 4, autoscaler still ok but during canary autoscale events might misbehave. consider temporarily setting hpa.minReplicas=3 during rollout.

Raj: also check the affinity rules — last time we saw AZ skew when replicas dropped and several pods ended up on same node.

sre-oncall: cluster is healthy atm but we have a maintenance window at 02:00 UTC tonight. prefer to do the change in that low-traffic window and monitor latency for 30m after.

Ashley: good call. i'll open the terraform PR and include both the deployment change and a PDB, and a note to set hpa.minReplicas=3 during rollout. will request canary deploy via the console.

Morgan: also add a canary label so we can target routing rule: `traffic.weight=10`.

Ashley: noted. tagging @Raj for review on HPA/minReplicas and podAntiAffinity.

Raj: will review in ~30m. quick check: are you changing resource requests? if you reduce replicas but bump cpu request it could spike binpacking.

Ashley: not planning resource changes this round; just rollout strategy + preStop + replicas. if things look noisy we can revert the replica count and only keep strategy changes.

deploy-bot: deploy-plan created for inference-api:pr-487 — plan shows 6->4 replicas change + new PDB. run `./infra apply --target=module.inference-api` when ready.

Ashley: thanks. i'll wait for @Raj and then schedule for 02:15 UTC if approved. will post updates here and add perf dashboards to the PR description.

Raj: quick nit: change readiness initialDelay to 8s, we saw flappy checks at 5s on larger images. otherwise LGTM.

Ashley: updated in the branch. thanks :thumbsup: 

sre-oncall: once applied i'll watch pod restarts and node CPU. ping me if any anomalies.

Ashley: will do. final plan: open PR, get two approvals (Raj + Morgan), schedule 02:15 UTC deployment, canary 10% for 15m, monitor dashboards, then roll remaining replicas. revert if p95 latency > 10% uplift.

Morgan: sounds good. cheers.
